---
version: "0.1"
name: "从 文学社素材004 抽取的设计契约"
description: "由 pptx-to-design-md skill 自动抽取; 字段已自动填值, 详见 EXTRACTION-REPORT.md 自动决策摘要"
audience: ""     # 由 Claude 看缩略图/正文后填入. 原始证据: 封面=个人作品集; 1 张扉页
locale: "zh-CN"                          # 🟢 基于字体 fallback chain 推断

canvas:
  aspectRatio: "1.75:1"           # 🟢 from presentation.xml/sldSz
  width: 720.0                          # 🟢
  height: 411.0                          # 🟢
  safeArea:                                # 🟡 视觉估计
    top: 24
    right: 32
    bottom: 32
    left: 32
  printSafe: false                         # 🔴 默认值

# grid 未在原 deck 中显式声明, 以下为视觉估计           # 🟡
grid:
  columns: 12
  gutter: 16
  margin: 32
  baseline: 8

colors:
  # ── 主色系 (HSV 主色相桶, 不预设色相) ──
  primary: "#CE544D"          # 🟡 pixel-sampled (2x)
  primary-deep: "#C75A48"          # 🟢 XML srgbClr (30x)
  primary-darkest: "#C00000"          # 🟢 XML srgbClr (103x)

  # ── 强调色 (互补色相桶, 与主色相距 ≥ 90°) ──
  accent: "#72BB2C"           # 🟢 XML srgbClr (1x)

  # ── 中性色 ──
  surface: "#FFFFFF"                       # 🟡 视觉估计
  surface-muted: "#F5F5F8"                 # 🟡
  on-surface: "#000000"                    # 🟢 XML srgbClr (avoid pure black)
  on-surface-secondary: "#6C7278"          # 🟡
  on-primary: "#FFFFFF"                    # 🔴 默认: 主色为深色时白字, 反之需手工调整

typography:
  # 主字体: 字魂59号-创粗黑 → fallback chain: default     # 🟢
  # 正文字体: 字魂59号-创粗黑 → fallback chain: default   # 🟢
  display:
    fontFamily: '"字魂59号-创粗黑", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif'
    fontWeight: 700                        # 🟢 (Bold)
    fontSize: 66                          # 🟢 (最大字号)
    lineHeight: 1.1                        # 🟡
    minProjectedSize: 48                 # 🔴 规范底线
  title:
    fontFamily: '"字魂59号-创粗黑", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif'
    fontWeight: 700
    fontSize: 32                          # 🟢
    lineHeight: 1.3
    minProjectedSize: 24
  body:
    fontFamily: '"字魂59号-创粗黑", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif'
    fontWeight: 500
    fontSize: 18                          # 🟢 基准字号
    lineHeight: 1.5
    minProjectedSize: 16                   # 🔴 规范底线
  body-small:
    fontFamily: '"字魂59号-创粗黑", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif'
    fontWeight: 500
    fontSize: 16                          # 🟢
    lineHeight: 1.4
  caption:
    fontFamily: '"字魂59号-创粗黑", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif'
    fontWeight: 500
    fontSize: 12                           # 🟢
    lineHeight: 1.3

# spacing 全部为视觉估计                                 # 🔴
spacing:
  xs: 4
  sm: 8
  md: 16
  lg: 24
  xl: 40
  xxl: 64

rounded:                                   # 🟡 视觉估计
  none: 0
  sm: 4
  md: 8
  pill: 9999

# imagery / iconography / patterns / motion / meta / doAndDont
# 这些字段由 Claude 在后续步骤根据缩略图归纳后补充
---
